# Offline piano samples

[简体中文](README.md)

FluidR3_GM acoustic grand piano by Frank Wen and contributors, converted by Benjamin Gleitzman and distributed by Paul Rosen. The 73 unmodified MP3 files come from the [YuE2 website sample directory](https://github.com/map-yue2/map-yue2.github.io/tree/main/vendor/soundfonts/FluidR3_GM/acoustic_grand_piano-mp3). The source tree and per-file Git blob SHA-1 hashes are recorded in `manifest.json`.

Samples are distributed under CC BY 3.0 US; original soundfont and conversion notices are preserved in [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt). They retain their own licenses. A song page embeds only the samples used by its score, including attribution and notices. Full song audio remains a separate file. Pitches outside the sampled range use the nearest sample with playback-rate transposition.
